question: Within 100 kilometers of Shavers Creek Environmental Center, Petersburg, PA, where can I find a café toward Vivi on Verbeke, Harrisburg, PA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Vivi on Verbeke%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Harrisburg%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.poi_name FROM pois AS P, start_point AS SP, end_point AS EP WHERE P.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, SP.geometry::geography, 100000) -- Within 100 kilometers (100,000 meters) AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the direction from start_point to the cafe -- and the direction from start_point to end_point. -- Filter for cafes that are within a 45-degree cone (22.5 degrees on either side) -- of the target direction. ABS( MOD( degrees(ST_Azimuth(SP.geometry, P.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(SP.geometry, EP.geometry)) + 180 + 360, 360 ) - 180 ) < 45 );
